title: Fix washed out colors on Intel GPU (X11)
summary: Set the Broadcast RGB mode to Full for your display output using xrandr to fix washed out colors on Intel GPUs under X11.

steps.explain: Identify your output name using xrandr.
Set the Broadcast RGB property to Full for your output. Replace <OUTPUT_NAME> with the name from the previous step (e.g., HDMI-1, eDP-1).

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of your display output (e.g., HDMI-1, eDP-1)
